about.description: Single-stock perpetual futures market on QFEX tracking Vistra Corp., quoted in USD, cross-margined in USDC and trading 24/7 with up to 10x leverage. QFEX is a hybrid central-limit-order-book exchange for traditional assets only; positions are cash-settled and confer no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Reference prices are consumed from primary venues during the instrument's published reference-price hours and funding is zero outside them. Added 2026-09-09 from QFEX's own /refdata API, reconciling 174 live USD-quoted ACTIVE markets against the 146 already carrying a row.
